context.why: Story 1 is accepted: Place (NAVIGATION, ACTION) and the OverviewPlaces mixin in fairdm/contrib/plugins/places.py, Mount, resolve(), get_page_actions() and validate_all() on PluginRegistry (registration.py), the option and mount checks in checks.py, the c-plugins.actions component and the overview.page_actions block in fairdm/templates/overview/page.html, and the plugin_sandbox fixture in tests/conftest.py that lets a page test register plugins and get real addresses for them. This story adds the third place: a card drawn inside the overview of a project, dataset, sample, measurement, person and organization, in the wide column or the side column, after the cards the page already has. A card has no page, no navigation entry and no page action. Nothing of a card may reach a viewer its access decision excludes, its assets included, and a card that raises must not take the page down.
spec_sections: Edge Cases (a predicate raises; a card's name clashes; a card on a private record; a card with nothing to show; a portal overrides an overview template; the same plugin wanted as a page and as a card; a column for something that is not a card)
plan_sections: D4 (get_cards, and a card contributing only its further views' patterns)
prior_decisions: decisions.md D4: a card is drawn by a method, not dispatched. `Card` in fairdm/contrib/plugins/cards.py is Plugin with template_name, get_context_data and optional Media, and render_card(request, record) returning the HTML. A registration with place='card' is refused when made unless the class can be drawn that way. Plugin.get_context_data adds breadcrumbs and the navigation menu, which a card does not need: Card supplies its own context (the record as `record` and `base_object`, the request) rather than inheriting a page's.

decisions.md D9 (story 1): Place has no CARD member and there is no Column yet, any `column` is refused, and Mount has no column field. This story adds Place.CARD, Column (SIDE, WIDE), the column field on Mount, and replaces the blanket refusal with the real rules in plan D2: an unknown column is refused; a column on something that is not a card is refused; place='card' with menu=False is refused; a card with no column gets the side column.

decisions.md D7, and it is the security-critical part of this story: a further view owned by a card is refused unless (1) the record type's overview opens for this viewer, (2) the card's own predicate AND permission pass, and (3) the view's own decision passes. `as_view` sets plugin_class on the view INSTANCE; the class attribute is None. So the owner must be read from self.plugin_class inside Plugin.has_permission, never from self.__class__.plugin_class. can_open(self.__class__, ...) does not see the owner at dispatch: that is how further views of pages work today, and it must stay exactly so for pages (SC-009). Apply the extra requirements only when the owner's mount is a card. For (1), find the record type's overview mount as the mount whose class is built on OverviewPlaces and ask can_open for it with the record. Test: a card with no predicate on a PRIVATE project, its further view requested by a stranger, is refused; requested by someone who can open the project, served.
A card contributes no URL pattern at its own name. Its further views are mounted beneath <name>/<segment>/ and named <name>-<view>, as a page's are.

OverviewPlaces draws cards in order, each: can_open for the card (False or raising skips it; raising is logged), then render_card inside try/except (a raise skips the card and is logged with logger.exception naming the card and the record), and only then adds the card's Media. The overview's own plugin_media in the context is None when the overview declares no Media, so the merge starts from an empty django.forms.Media. base.html already writes plugin_media.css and plugin_media.js.

overview/page.html: loop over overview_cards.wide after the overview.main block and over overview_cards.side after the overview.side block, each inside its column div and inside a new block (overview.contributed_main, overview.contributed_side). With no cards the loops write nothing at all: no wrapper element (FR-021). Add both blocks to the block list in the template's opening comment.
decisions.md D5: cards are sorted by (order, name). get_cards(model) mirrors get_page_actions(model).

decisions.md D3: a card against a record type none of whose plugins is built on OverviewPlaces (Point) is refused by validate_all. validate_places_offered in checks.py already does this for actions: extend it.
A card with nothing to show is still drawn (FR-024): the framework never inspects a card's output for emptiness.

Page tests use the plugin_sandbox fixture from tests/conftest.py (decisions.md D11). To check that a contributed card follows the page's own cards, compare positions in the response against something the page already emits, such as the id or data attribute of an existing card; if none exists, a card of your own registered earlier in order is not enough, so add a data- hook to the contributed-card loop's output rather than to the page's existing cards.

acceptance.given_when_then: Given a registry filled by the test, when cards are registered, then the outcomes in tasks.md T006 hold: refusals at registration, the side column by default, card order independent of registration order, no pattern at the card's own name, no navigation entry or page action, render_card draws with the record and request, and a card against Point is refused by validate_all.

Given User Story 2's scenarios, when each record type's overview is opened through the test client, then a card's content is in the page only for a viewer it admits, in its column after the page's own cards and in order; a failing card is left out with the page still served and the failure logged; a hidden card's further views are refused, including on a private record for a card with no predicate; and its assets are present only when it is drawn.
Given the failing tests from T006 and T007, when the implementation lands, then all pass and every test that existed at the base passes, changed only as the brief allows.

Given create_a_plugin.md, overview-pages.md and CONTEXT.md, when read against the branch, then they say how to register a card with an example that runs, covering the column, a further view and assets, what the card refusals are, that a card's further views are refused unless the overview opens and the card's own rule passes, and what an overview card is.
